kind: Existing R05 Gate A corrective source checkpoint — founding layout and geometry lifetime
scope: Only the two requested dirty Unity corrections and their directly surrounding publication/withdrawal paths. No deferred-intent implementation reviewed here.
head: 64766c7443b987132efdd217baa0ab61eea7c574

sourceResolutions.finding: The new shared Administration heading removes the extra calendar plus full-width Industry block that caused the run10 six-person review overflow. It retains Industry navigation in AdminOverview and AdminOperations. Actual final layout remains a native check.
sourceResolutions.geometry: PublishFoundingControl converts the local layout rect into GUI screen coordinates, intersects with the current BeginArea rectangle, rejects intersections no larger than 4px, then converts to bottom-origin screen space. This prevents the run10 below-card center from being represented by a full unclipped target.

sourceResolutions.finding: Each geometry publication now withdraws only names this publisher previously owned, then publishes active/enabled current entities with valid projected bounds. Removed, disabled and no-longer-projectable entities disappear on the next publishing update. OnDisable clears the owned names. No selection or simulation authority was changed.

issues.severity: Small correctness gap in the requested geometry seam
issues.finding: An unusable clipped rectangle returns without withdrawing its own prior name. Most founding names are cleared by WithdrawFoundingControls, but admin-open-industry is outside that list, and its separate WithdrawOpenHistoryRect path is not called on every AdminOperations repaint. An existing Industry rectangle can therefore survive a later unusable intersection on that layer.
issues.remedy: Withdraw the given name before returning from the unusable-intersection branch (or before each attempted publication).
issues.nativeRelation: Prevents geometry lifetime from depending on a separate layer cleanup path; does not claim this edge was exercised natively.

issues.severity: Small correctness gap in the requested geometry seam
issues.finding: When the picking camera becomes unavailable while the manager remains enabled, Update returns before PublishSelectableGeometry withdraws old entries. A previously projected rect then remains in the registry without a camera capable of producing a current rect.
issues.nativeRelation: Source branch inspection only; the run10 camera remained present.

preservedBehavior: No action is committed by geometry publication or by the new navigation heading.
Other registry publishers are not cleared by SelectionManager.
Global native input guards and authoritative command handling remain unchanged by these two diffs.

Verify opening Industry still works from both founding and operational Administration.
After hiring/removing/replacing applicants, compare actual bodies with the next map: retired world-selectable names must be absent.
Verify geometry publication does not retain a control after its area no longer has a usable intersection.
limitations: Read-only source review only; no source edits, tests, build, engine or native input started by reviewer.
